title: Admissions open for 2026–27
summary: Applications are invited for Pre-KG to Standard IX and Standard XI for the academic year beginning June 2026.
body: Admission is open to all irrespective of caste, creed or status. Admission to higher classes depends on the availability of seats and an entrance test; admission to Standard XI for students from other schools is based on Class X marks. Apply online or collect an application form from the school office.

title: CMHSS online picture-story writing competition
summary: Online picture-story writing competition for Classes III, IV and V.
body: Students of Classes III, IV and V took part in an online picture-story writing competition organised by the school during the summer break.

title: CMHSS online quiz competition
summary: Online quiz for Classes VI, VII and VIII on science, mathematics and general knowledge.
body: An online quiz competition on the syllabus of science, mathematics and general knowledge was conducted for Classes VI to VIII.

title: CMHSS online fancy dress competition
summary: Fancy dress competition for Classes I and II on the theme “National leaders”.
body: The youngest classes dressed up as national leaders for an online fancy dress competition judged by the kindergarten and primary teachers.

title: Admission started for academic year 2021–22
summary: Admission opened for LKG to IX and XI for the 2021–22 academic year.
body: Admission opened for LKG to Standard IX and Standard XI for the 2021–22 academic year.
